about: PRD/PRD-胶片指南卡片与风格.md §6. Hand-written card copy for every stock. status: draft (to be reviewed) | approved. tags: the scenes a person adds by hand; lowLight, tungsten, cinematic and bw are also derived from data by Tools/gen-catalog.py. An empty summary is a gap left for the owner to fill.

fujifilm_c200.en: Fujifilm's entry-level consumer negative: light colour, an everyday snapshot film.
fujifilm_c200.zh: 富士入门级民用负片，色彩清淡，常见于日常快照。

fujifilm_pro_400h.en: Soft colour leaning cyan-green, often used for bright portraits and weddings.
fujifilm_pro_400h.zh: 色调清淡、偏青绿，常用于明亮的人像和婚礼。

fujifilm_xtra_400.en: Fujifilm's fast consumer negative, for everyday shooting and middling light.
fujifilm_xtra_400.zh: 富士民用高感负片，日常和光线一般的场景都能用。

kodak_ektar_100.en: Very fine grain and high saturation, for landscapes and travel.
kodak_ektar_100.zh: 颗粒很细、饱和度高，适合风景和旅行。

kodak_gold_200.en: A warm consumer negative with a nostalgic look.
kodak_gold_200.zh: 偏暖的民用负片，带怀旧感。

kodak_portra_160.en: A slow portrait negative: soft skin tones, low contrast.
kodak_portra_160.zh: 低感人像负片，肤色柔和、反差低。

kodak_portra_400.en: One of the most used portrait negatives: natural skin tones, wide latitude.
kodak_portra_400.zh: 最常用的人像负片之一，肤色自然、宽容度大。

kodak_portra_800.en: A fast portrait negative for dimmer light.
kodak_portra_800.zh: 高感人像负片，适合光线较暗的场景。

kodak_portra_800_push1.en: Portra 800 pushed one stop in development: more contrast.
kodak_portra_800_push1.zh: Portra 800 增感一档冲洗，反差更强。

kodak_portra_800_push2.en: Portra 800 pushed two stops: more contrast, for very dark scenes.
kodak_portra_800_push2.zh: Portra 800 增感两档冲洗，反差更强，适合很暗的环境。

kodak_ultramax_400.en: Kodak's fast consumer negative: warm, made for snapshots.
kodak_ultramax_400.zh: 柯达民用高感负片，偏暖，适合随手拍。

fujifilm_provia_100f.en: A slide film with relatively neutral, accurate colour.
fujifilm_provia_100f.zh: 色彩相对中性、准确的反转片。

fujifilm_velvia_100.en: A slide film with very high saturation and strong contrast, a landscape favourite.
fujifilm_velvia_100.zh: 饱和度很高、反差强，风光摄影常用。

kodak_ektachrome_100.en: A slide film with clean colour.

kodak_kodachrome_64.en: The classic slide film: rich colour with a sense of its era.
kodak_kodachrome_64.zh: 经典老牌反转片，色彩浓郁、带年代感。

kodak_tri_x_400.en: The classic black-and-white film: visible grain, bold contrast, the documentary standard.
kodak_tri_x_400.zh: 经典黑白胶片，颗粒感和反差鲜明，纪实摄影的代表。

ilford_hp5_plus_400.en: A black-and-white film with wide latitude and visible grain, common in street and documentary work.
ilford_hp5_plus_400.zh: 宽容度大、颗粒明显的黑白胶片，纪实街拍常用。

kodak_tmax_100.en: A modern black-and-white film with very fine grain: sharp and clean.
kodak_tmax_100.zh: 颗粒非常细的现代黑白胶片，锐利干净。

fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.en: A black-and-white film with very fine grain and smooth tones.
fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.zh: 颗粒很细、影调细腻的黑白胶片。

kodak_vision3_50d.en: A slow daylight motion-picture negative with fine grain.
kodak_vision3_50d.zh: 低感日光型电影负片，颗粒细。

kodak_vision3_250d.en: A daylight motion-picture negative, one of the most common sources of the cinematic look.
kodak_vision3_250d.zh: 日光型电影负片，“电影感”最常见的来源之一。

kodak_vision3_200t.en: A motion-picture negative balanced for tungsten light (its profile's reference illuminant is T).
kodak_vision3_200t.zh: 按钨丝灯平衡的电影负片（配置的参考光源为 T）。

kodak_vision3_500t.en: A fast tungsten-balanced motion-picture negative, common for night scenes and interiors.
kodak_vision3_500t.zh: 高感灯光型电影负片，夜景和室内常用。

kodak_portra_endura.en: A professional paper aimed at portraits, with softer contrast.
kodak_portra_endura.zh: 面向人像的专业相纸，反差较柔。

kodak_supra_endura.en: A professional paper with medium contrast; this app's default paper.
kodak_supra_endura.zh: 专业相纸，反差居中；本应用的默认相纸。

kodak_ultra_endura.en: A professional paper with higher saturation.

fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii.en: Fujifilm's colour paper, the default for Fujifilm negatives.
fujifilm_crystal_archive_typeii.zh: 富士彩色相纸，富士负片的默认搭配。

kodak_2383.en: The standard cinema release print film, the other half of the cinematic pairing.
kodak_2383.zh: 影院放映拷贝的标准片种，“电影感”组合的另一半。

kodak_2393.en: A premium release print film with higher contrast and saturation.
kodak_2393.zh: 高端放映拷贝片，反差和饱和度更高。

ilford_multigrade_iv_rc.en: A variable-contrast resin-coated black-and-white paper; every black-and-white film in this app prints on it.
ilford_multigrade_iv_rc.zh: 可变反差的树脂涂层黑白相纸，本应用的黑白胶片都印在它上面。
